## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Running analyze_failures.py over a fixture with the same gap reported by two...

The system SHALL ensure that running analyze_failures.py over a fixture with the same gap reported by two sources yields one ranked finding with source_count 2 rather than two raw entries.

#### Scenario: Running analyze_failures.py over a fixture with the same gap reported by two...

WHEN `rank-deduplicated-multi-source-findings` is implemented
THEN Running analyze_failures.py over a fixture with the same gap reported by two sources yields one ranked finding with source_count 2 rather than two raw entries.

### Requirement: generate_report_multi_source is invoked from main() and its output section...

The system SHALL ensure that generate_report_multi_source is invoked from main() and its output section appears in the generated improvement report (asserted by test).

#### Scenario: generate_report_multi_source is invoked from main() and its output section...

WHEN `rank-deduplicated-multi-source-findings` is implemented
THEN generate_report_multi_source is invoked from main() and its output section appears in the generated improvement report (asserted by test).

### Requirement: GitHub issue #494 is closed by the merged change

The system SHALL ensure that gitHub issue #494 is closed by the merged change.

#### Scenario: GitHub issue #494 is closed by the merged change

WHEN `rank-deduplicated-multi-source-findings` is implemented
THEN GitHub issue #494 is closed by the merged change.
